title: Refrigerant Price List and Per-Visit Limits — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, refrigerant is sold by the pound and by refrigerant type. Prices are the same in every call class; the pounds that may be added on one visit are not.

| Call class | R-410A per pound | R-22 per pound | R-454B per pound | Most pounds added on one visit | Most pounds of R-22 on one visit | Pounds on one unit within 12 months above which a leak search is offered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | $89.00 | $165.00 | $112.00 | 10 | 4 | 4 |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | $89.00 | $165.00 | $112.00 | 10 | 4 | 4 |
| Evening Service Call | $89.00 | $165.00 | $112.00 | 10 | 4 | 4 |
| Weekend Service Call | $89.00 | $165.00 | $112.00 | 10 | 4 | 4 |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | $89.00 | $165.00 | $112.00 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | $89.00 | $165.00 | $112.00 | 4 | 4 | 4 |

## Reading the list

- Prices are per pound added. No labor multiplier applies to refrigerant.
- The visit limit covers all refrigerant added on one visit. The R-22 limit of 4 pounds applies within that visit limit in every class.
- The leak-search figure looks at the refrigerant added to the same unit within 12 months.

## Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

| Visit | Refrigerant added | Billed |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call, R-410A | 3 pounds | 3 pounds at $89.00, $267.00 |
| Weekend Service Call, R-454B | 2.5 pounds | 2.5 pounds at $112.00, $280.00 |
| Evening Service Call, R-22 | 4 pounds (the R-22 limit) | 4 pounds at $165.00, $660.00 |

On an Overnight Emergency Service Call or a Holiday Emergency Service Call, no more than 4 pounds of any refrigerant can be added on the visit.
